title: RetrievalRequest
description: One request to the worker's per-tenant retrieval index. An index request replaces or adds documents in the tenant's namespace; a search request returns the closest documents in that same namespace. Written by Kone Tshivhinda & Claude.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version. A breaking change needs a new major.

tenantId.description: The namespace every document and query in this request belongs to. Documents do not carry their own tenant.

documents.description: Documents to add or replace in this tenant's namespace. A document with an existing id replaces that entry.

documentId.description: Caller-owned id, typically a matter id. The worker does not interpret it.

text.description: Text to embed. The worker stores only the resulting vector.

query.description: Text to embed and compare with the documents in this tenant's namespace.

topK.description: Maximum matches to return. Defaults to 5 when omitted.
